seo.home.title: LumaForge | Browser-Local RAW Photo Lab
seo.home.description: Open one camera RAW locally, shape tone and color, inspect the histogram, compare the result, and export a full-resolution JPEG when the pipeline is reproducible.
seo.raw.title: RAW Lab | LumaForge
seo.raw.description: Open the browser-local RAW lab to adjust tone and color, compare the result, and export a trustworthy full-resolution JPEG.
landing.heroImageAlt: Drag or use the arrow keys to explore an illustrative muted and color treatment of red spider lilies.
landing.heroTitle: Finish the RAW, without the editing cockpit.
landing.heroCopy: Preview the camera file, shape tone and color, inspect the histogram, compare the original, then export a full-resolution JPEG when the pipeline can be reproduced. A LUT is optional. The RAW stays on your device.
landing.formats: Opens .ARW, .NEF, .CR3, .CR2, .RAF, .RW2, .ORF, .DNG, .PEF and {{more}} more RAW formats. No account, no install, no upload.
landing.workflow.title: One file. The whole decision path.
landing.workflow.intro: LumaForge keeps the useful controls and gives each one a clear place between camera file and finished JPEG.
landing.workflow.0.label: Open the RAW
landing.workflow.0.detail: Common camera RAW extensions open locally. An embedded preview appears first when the file provides one.
landing.workflow.1.label: Shape the light
landing.workflow.1.detail: Set exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, and blacks without leaving the finishing flow.
landing.workflow.2.label: Shape the color
landing.workflow.2.detail: Adjust temperature, tint, saturation, vibrance, and eight-band HSL. Bring a declared `.cube` LUT only when you want one.
landing.workflow.3.label: Inspect the result
landing.workflow.3.detail: Read RGB or luminance histograms, watch clipped shadows and highlights, then compare the original in the same frame.
landing.workflow.4.label: Export with proof
landing.workflow.4.detail: Create a full-resolution JPEG only when the browser runtime can reproduce the resolved color graph.
landing.evidence.title: The same controls feed preview and export.
landing.evidence.copy: This is a real Chromium session running SGL00940.ARW in LumaForge. The frame-anchored compare, histogram, tone and color controls, and full-resolution export gate all share one workspace.
landing.evidence.alt: Actual LumaForge RAW Lab session showing a split comparison of red spider lilies, a histogram, tone controls, and the full-resolution JPEG export gate.
landing.evidence.caption: Actual browser session · SGL00940.ARW
landing.pipeline.title: Adjustments and export share one color intent.
landing.pipelineAria: Color pipeline from RAW development to JPEG
landing.pipeline.note: The same tone and color intent feeds preview, histogram, compare, and export. A LUT only joins the graph when its input and output contract is known.
landing.trust.0.title: Local RAW handling
landing.trust.0.text: Your camera file is read on this device and handed to browser workers, not an upload queue.
landing.trust.1.title: Preview is not export
landing.trust.1.text: Responsive preview can use embedded, quick, or bounded HQ stages. Full-resolution export has its own authority.
landing.trust.2.title: Fail closed by design
landing.trust.2.text: If the declared graph cannot be reproduced safely, export stops and explains why.
landing.final.title: Open the RAW lab. Finish the photograph.
landing.final.copy: Bring a camera file. Leave with a JPEG you adjusted, inspected, and exported on purpose.
